title: Union Minister Smt. Annpurna Devi Hails 10 Years of UPI as an Example of India's Digital Revolution
body_text:
Union Minister of Women and Child Development, Smt. Annpurna Devi has hailed the completion of 10 years of the Unified Payments Interface (UPI).
In a post on ‘X’ the Union Minister said that the 10-year journey of UPI has become such an example of the digital revolution that it has made India a new power of digital payments before the world.
UPI के 10 साल का सफर, डिजिटल क्रांति की ऐसी मिसाल बना, जिसने भारत को दुनिया के सामने डिजिटल भुगतान की नई शक्ति बना दिया। #10YearsOfUPI pic.twitter.com/sC2irOInDW — Annpurna Devi (@Annapurna4BJP) August 25, 2026
